description: Exclude ground and hover test routes.
Clip negative battery current readings to zero.
Correct four likely clock transcription errors using neighbouring flight times; preserve original times. Corrections are inferred, not independently verified.

Flag R1 design flights using group-median deviations in energy, duration and mean power, scaled by global median absolute deviations and thresholded at Q3 + 1.5*IQR. Flights are retained. This implementation flags 15 flights; D4 reports 4 using an unspecified formula, so results differ.
